Summary Business Data Analyst with 4+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Private Equity, Venture Capital, and Alternative Investments, specializing in Data Governance, Business Analysis, and Investment Data Management. Experienced in business requirement gathering, BRD/FRD preparation, metadata management, data quality, data validation, governance frameworks, and collaborating with data stewards, data owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve data integrity and governance processes. Skilled in SQL, Power BI, stakeholder management, and delivering data-driven insights across M&A, valuations, cap tables, transaction data, fixed income, derivatives, and investment datasets to support investment and operational decision-making.

Professional Experience BlackRock – Bengaluru, Karnataka Analyst - Data Governance

Feb ‘23- Present





• •



• •

Developed a Private Markets Index covering 200+ high-value pre-IPO US companies, collaborating with the Strategy team to support investment tracking and benchmarking. Led end-to-end governance of M&A and private equity transactions, performing business requirement analysis, documenting functional requirements, and validating data across portfolio companies, funds, valuations, and ownership structures. Performed valuation analysis (DCF, trading comps, pre/post-money) using Excel, SQL, and Power BI on structured financial datasets. Analyzed financial performance metrics (revenue, EBITDA, net debt, capex), delivering audit-ready insights. Extracted and reconciled ownership, cap table, and transaction data from statutory filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, AoA, shareholder registers, capital records). Standardized deal classification frameworks by analyzing business processes and stakeholder requirements, improving consistency and comparability across investment datasets Supported buy-side due diligence, company profiling, and sector research across Healthcare, Energy, FIG, TMT, and FMCG. Delivered market intelligence and deal coverage across 800+ US s UK companies, enabling transaction-ready insights. Reconciled datasets across Preqin Pro, Bloomberg, and regulatory filings, performing variance analysis using SQL and Excel to improve data reliability. Verified entity-level data via SEC/EDGAR, MCA, and Companies House filings.

• Managed workflows via JIRA, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps and improve processes. • •

Analyzed 300+ companies and G00+ fundraising rounds across funds, managers, and service providers. Built MIS dashboards (Power BI, SQL) tracking KPIs, error trends, and SLA performance while preparing MI reports and executive dashboards for stakeholders to support governance and operational decision-making. Prepared business documentation including Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process documentation, and functional specifications to support reporting enhancements and data governance initiatives.

Nov ‘21- Nov ‘22



Executed AML/KYC workflows, including entity verification and ownership mapping across 1,500+ entities.

Built detailed profiles of companies and individuals using global regulatory filings and intelligence databases.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
Professional Experience BlackRock – Bengaluru, Karnataka Analyst - Data Governance
Feb ‘23- Present


• •

• •
Developed a Private Markets Index covering 200+ high-value pre-IPO US companies, collaborating with the Strategy team to support investment tracking and benchmarking. Led end-to-end governance of M&A and private equity transactions, performing business requirement analysis, documenting functional requirements, and validating data across portfolio companies, funds, valuations, and ownership structures. Performed valuation analysis (DCF, trading comps, pre/post-money) using Excel, SQL, and Power BI on structured financial datasets. Analyzed financial performance metrics (revenue, EBITDA, net debt, capex), delivering audit-ready insights. Extracted and reconciled ownership, cap table, and transaction data from statutory filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, AoA, shareholder registers, capital records). Standardized deal classification frameworks by analyzing business processes and stakeholder requirements, improving consistency and comparability across investment datasets Supported buy-side due diligence, company profiling, and sector research across Healthcare, Energy, FIG, TMT, and FMCG. Delivered market intelligence and deal coverage across 800+ US s UK companies, enabling transaction-ready insights. Reconciled datasets across Preqin Pro, Bloomberg, and regulatory filings, performing variance analysis using SQL and Excel to improve data reliability. Verified entity-level data via SEC/EDGAR, MCA, and Companies House filings.
• Managed workflows via JIRA, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps and improve processes. • •
Analyzed 300+ companies and G00+ fundraising rounds across funds, managers, and service providers. Built MIS dashboards (Power BI, SQL) tracking KPIs, error trends, and SLA performance while preparing MI reports and executive dashboards for stakeholders to support governance and operational decision-making. Prepared business documentation including Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process documentation, and functional specifications to support reporting enhancements and data governance initiatives.

Zigram – Gurugram, Haryana Research Analyst
Nov ‘21- Nov ‘22

Executed AML/KYC workflows, including entity verification and ownership mapping across 1,500+ entities.

Identified and catalogued 2,000+ PEPs, Hate Groups, HNWIs, and related entities for risk and compliance assessment.

Built detailed profiles of companies and individuals using global regulatory filings and intelligence databases.

Improved data validation processes, reducing turnaround time and increasing workflow efficiency.

Delivered analytical reports and insights to support decision-making across high-priority projects.
Mentored 5+ associates, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to standards.

Developed Excel-based trackers and databases to streamline analysis and reporting.
